referenceInventory.title: Soft sign, hard sign, and Й
Offline reference for object-row agreement, review-pending. Match gender, number, and case together, and do not change gender silently.
Offline reference for aspect, review-pending. Aspect pairs are bounded, быть is imperfective, and an imperfective past need not mean the event was unfinished.
Offline reference for motion, review-pending. Translate only the motion and destination that the Russian sentence contains.
Offline reference for past passive, review-pending. Required stress stays on напи́санный and прочи́танный. Present passive exploration is optional.
Offline reference for verbal adverbs, review-pending. Imperfective forms are simultaneous with the main predicate and perfective forms are anterior to it.

scope: Static content/depth review and introduced-unit projection. Not 30 UI executions, test counts, source/rights/linguistic qualification or full MA2-068 acceptance. Lesson pointers are research candidates, not app reference entries.
